$schema_note: Non-normative machine-readable binding matrix. Consumed by /app/frontend/src/lib/conformanceCore.js and validated by /app/frontend/tests/bindingMatrix.test.mjs.
notes: Requirement IDs are IMPL-scoped (REQ-*-*) until a normative Aura Protocol specification is supplied.
Each row is intentionally atomic: one invariant maps to exactly one implementation check function.
Rows with impl_check_id=null are declared gaps and are enumerated so they can never be silently claimed as PASS.

invariants.statement: Every decision record MUST carry a non-empty `id` and a full `evidence` object with canonical_representation, canonical_hash, prev_hash, chain_hash.
For every decision, canonicalize(payload_without_evidence) MUST equal evidence.canonical_representation byte-for-byte.
caveats: Canonicalization is JCS-lite (sorted keys, in-order arrays, no whitespace, JSON string encoding). Numeric serialization is pinned by INV-FLT-01. Pending normative Aura specification (RFC 8785 or equivalent).

invariants.statement: For every decision, sha256Hex(evidence.canonical_representation) MUST equal evidence.canonical_hash.

For i=0, evidence.prev_hash MUST equal 64 zero hex characters (genesis). For i>0, evidence.prev_hash MUST equal the recomputed chain_hash of decision[i-1]. For every i, evidence.chain_hash MUST equal sha256Hex(prev_hash || canonical_hash).
invariants.cascade: Any mutation of any record's canonical payload propagates to that record's canonical_hash and chain_hash, which in turn breaks the prev_hash link of every subsequent record.

invariants.statement: For every decision, decision.policy_version MUST be a non-empty string that is a member of session.registered_policy_versions.

A deterministic mutation of a decision's payload on an isolated deep-clone MUST cause the real verifier to fail both canonical_representation and sha256_integrity for that record. The original bundle MUST NOT be mutated by the probe.
invariants.note: This is a runtime probe, not a static assertion; PASS iff the real verifier detects the mutation.

invariants.statement: Every finite IEEE-754 double MUST be serialized by ECMAScript §6.1.6.1.13 Number::toString (bit-exact). NaN, +Infinity, -Infinity MUST be rejected (canonicalizer MUST throw). See /app/docs/INV_FLT_01_NUMERIC_CANONICALIZATION.md.
invariants.note: Runtime fixture-based probe. Cross-implementation parity is additionally asserted by /app/py_verifier/tests/test_numeric_canonicalization.py.

invariants.statement: An exported evidence bundle MUST be independently verifiable by /app/cli/aura-verify.mjs (Node) and /app/py_verifier/aura_verify.py (Python stdlib) without mutation of the bundle file.
invariants.note: Reported at runtime as PASS because a positive-and-negative portability test matrix exists in the repository and is executed in CI-equivalent scripts.

invariants.statement: Two independent verifier implementations (Node ESM + Python stdlib) MUST produce the same overall result and the same per-test status for every bundle in the parametric mutation matrix.
invariants.note: Cross-implementation agreement is established out-of-band by parametric test matrices; it is NOT a runtime property of a single verifier invocation and is therefore honestly reported NOT IMPLEMENTED by any single verifier.

invariants.statement: An attestation signature over a canonical attestation payload MUST verify against a public key that is registered as active in the trusted out-of-band registry and whose validity window brackets `signed_at`. Revoked keys MUST fail regardless of timestamp.
invariants.note: Reported NOT APPLICABLE when the bundle has no attestation block; PASS/FAIL when present.
